description: PASS2-11: FetchAction and FetchDecision share 'Fetch' prefix. FetchAction::Follow and LoopAction::Redirect both mean 'follow redirect' at different levels. Rename FetchAction to RedirectDecision. Files: src/vug/fetch_types.cr, src/vug/redirect_handler*.cr

comments.text: Stale — resolved. FetchAction was refactored away by vugcr-khz epic; the loop now uses LoopAction + FetchDecision (see fetch_decision.cr, loop_action.cr). The remaining FetchAction references in redirect_handler* are a separate concern; this rename is no longer applicable.

title: API: Rename FetchAction to RedirectDecision for clarity
